title: AJO Engagement Strategy Entity Fields
description: Engagement strategy fields for AJO entity records.

https://ns.adobe.com/experience/customer.title: Engagement Strategy Entity
https://ns.adobe.com/experience/customer.description: Identifies the engagement strategy associated with an AJO entity record.

xdm:id.title: Engagement Strategy ID
xdm:id.description: ID for the engagement strategy. Related journey, arbitration node, and message entity records can populate this field to identify the strategy that was evaluated.

xdm:name.title: Engagement Strategy Name
xdm:name.description: Name for the engagement strategy. This field is populated on the entity record representing the engagement strategy itself.
